title: CREATE_PASSIVE_SELL_OFFER returns a MANAGE_SELL_OFFER result
pattern: The operation is create_passive_sell_offer, but core turns it into a manage-sell-offer internally (CreatePassiveSellOfferOpFrame.cpp:13), so the result arm is manage_sell_offer. Readers that pair results with operations by type break on every passive offer.

hazards.placement: OperationResult arm manage_sell_offer for a CREATE_PASSIVE_SELL_OFFER operation

facts.says: The result arm is manage_sell_offer, and the offer is created.
